authorization: User requested source debugging and fixes with generated tests; no release approval was supplied or synthesized.

failure_groups.finding: Rejected Planner output was cached/reused; invalid revisions escaped bounded retry accounting.
failure_groups.repair: Record rejected bytes/findings; persistent pre-dispatch revision reservations and fresh failure context.

failure_groups.finding: Replanning after feasibility failure could crash Coder context on missing result fields.
failure_groups.repair: Preserve result/resume-state provenance and distinguish historic feasibility from current implementation failure.

failure_groups.finding: String/number remote authorization could be truthy; malformed automation settings failed late.
failure_groups.repair: Strict booleans, bounded integer budget, typed maps/strings and unknown-field rejection.

failure_groups.finding: Invalid/incomplete Coder traces could leave trusted source dirty.
failure_groups.repair: Validate exact delta, task/requirement/design binding and completeness before application; preserve rejection evidence.

failure_groups.finding: Nested Codex transport accepted duplicate keys and non-finite JSON numbers.
failure_groups.repair: Reject ambiguous JSON rather than normalizing it into apparently valid output.

failure_groups.finding: Plan tasks could advertise paths outside the approved include scope.
failure_groups.repair: Conservative task-pattern containment plus explicit repo-relative path diagnostics; final concrete scope checks remain.

failure_groups.finding: Trusted Git lost SSH agent variables and interpreted colon-prefixed file paths as pathspec syntax.
failure_groups.repair: Forward SSH variables only to trusted Git and force literal pathspecs/noninteractive transport.

failure_groups.finding: Trusted Docker calls lost TLS/configuration environment settings.
failure_groups.repair: Preserve Docker TLS verification/certificate/config variables at that boundary only.

failure_groups.finding: Read-only Docker mount targets accepted traversal/noncanonical components.
failure_groups.repair: Reject empty, dot and parent components before starting Docker.

failure_groups.finding: Delivery validated only the first push URL.
failure_groups.repair: Reject multiple fetch/push destinations instead of risking an unapproved extra push.

failure_groups.finding: Bitbucket approval could be revoked while comments were paginated.
failure_groups.repair: Re-read current participants after comment retrieval before accepting a SHA-specific approval.

failure_groups.finding: Existing public state directories could expose controller/independent-test data.
failure_groups.repair: Reject non-owner-only state before opening the ledger; validate CLI state locations before writes; private migration staging.

failure_groups.finding: Old incompatible generations could not retire; active child generations did not protect their base.
failure_groups.repair: Permit retirement without availability/provider compatibility, but prevent retirement of a base used by a promoted child.

failure_groups.finding: Coder copying and job/receipt publication were not crash-atomic.
failure_groups.repair: Durable before/after CAS journals, rollback, explicit recover-role, and job/receipt publication in one transaction.

failure_groups.finding: Wrong-stage, unbound or semantically invalid pre-approval outputs could become permanent cached failures.
failure_groups.repair: Exact stage/reference contracts and bounded replanning for Tester design/testability, Coder handoff and Planner reconciliation.

failure_groups.finding: A cumulative revert could create a commit before empty-candidate rejection.
failure_groups.repair: Reject an empty baseline-to-tree delta before commit.

failure_groups.finding: Pre-commit interruption could not recover; another work item's intent could hijack recovery.
failure_groups.repair: Match pending work/package identities and exact tree; recover both commit phases without rerunning Coder.

failure_groups.finding: Current operational guidance and packaging did not identify the repaired source/kit and recovery boundary.
failure_groups.repair: Repair ID, trace/provenance, fresh kit identities and manifests; correct one-human-per-gate hardware denial text.
